title: Replacing council tax with a land value tax: a household-level microsimulation for the UK
description: A household-level microsimulation framework for land value tax reform in the UK, applied to replacing council tax. A budget-neutral 0.79% rate leaves two thirds of households better off, with incidence organised by wealth rather than income.

title: Who bears the AI shock? The distributional and fiscal incidence in the UK
description: Linking occupation-level AI exposure to the Family Resources Survey, this paper simulates employment, wage and capital-income shocks across 66 scenarios. The central calibration costs the Exchequer £17.7 billion a year and raises absolute poverty by 1.87 percentage points.

title: An open firm-level microsimulation for UK VAT threshold policy analysis
description: An open firm-level microsimulation for transparent, conditional costing of UK VAT registration-threshold reforms, characterising the notch through a £21,250 dominated region above the £85,000 threshold.
